components.purpose: Full-width opening banner with heading, description and two buttons. Placed at the top; it is the only component that combines a full-width background with two CTAs.
Customer logos row as social proof, directly under the opening banner.
Features grid with screenshots. Bento cards show graphics well; FeatureGrid is for icon-and-text features, so it doesn't fit a screenshot-led grid.
Three key stats as a single row of value and label tiles. It fits a plain row of numbers without a background image; CompanyStats is the alternative if a titled, image-backed section is wanted.
One customer quote. The single-quote component is used instead of Testimonials, which shows a list of several quotes.
Final contact form at the bottom of the page, with heading, description, and submission messages.
